rationale: Every 68-95-99.7 arithmetic step is correct and internally consistent: 90-110 (1σ)=68%, 80-120 (2σ)=95%, above 120 (1 tail of the outer 5%)=2.5%, 110-120 (between 1σ and 2σ, one side)= (95-68)/2=13.5%, beyond 3σ=100-99.7=0.3%.
